title: PolySage AI — Production RAG & Agentic AI Platform
description: Built at the Claude Builder Club Hackathon. An end-to-end RAG platform using LangChain, Claude and FAISS, combining agentic workflows, prompt engineering, vector search and intelligent caching. Achieved 98.5% reliability and a 40% cache-hit rate, deployed via FastAPI on AWS with Docker, Kubernetes, evaluation harnesses and CI/CD.

title: MLOps Lifecycle Template
description: End-to-end MLOps lifecycle in one repo: training, an MLflow registry with gated promotion, hot-reload FastAPI serving, Evidently drift monitoring with alerting, and GitHub Actions CI/CD with automatic rollback.

title: Real-Time Recommendation System
description: Real-time recommender on MovieLens-25M: two-tower retrieval with logQ-corrected in-batch softmax, LightGBM LambdaRank reranking, and FastAPI serving with Redis feature caching and cold-start fallbacks. 2.1x recall@10 over a popularity baseline at a p99 of 5.6ms.

title: DocProof — Evaluation-Driven Document Extraction
description: Document extraction built around evaluation: Claude structured outputs, per-field confidence from deterministic validators, review-queue routing, a LangGraph retry loop, and a golden test set with LLM-as-judge graders gating regressions in CI.

title: Multi-Agent Data Analyst
description: Multi-agent data analyst on LangGraph and Claude: parallel analyst fan-out, sandboxed pandas execution, a critic revision loop, and per-agent token accounting — with orchestration testable without an API key.

title: LLM Fine-Tune & Quantization Benchmark
description: QLoRA fine-tune of Qwen2.5-1.5B on GSM8K running on a 4GB laptop GPU, paired with a quantized inference benchmark across fp16, int8 and nf4. Exact-match moved from 1.5–5.5% at base to 54–60% tuned, with measured accuracy, throughput and VRAM trade-offs.

title: Adversarially Robust AI Assistant
description: Fine-tuned DistilGPT2 with FreeLB adversarial training on 10K curated pairs and built an LLM evaluation harness, reaching a 0% prompt-injection rate and 18% fewer hallucinations. Deployed on Azure with Flask, Docker and RLHF-inspired feedback loops.

title: Scalable Face Recognition System Using AWS IaaS
description: Cloud-native facial recognition system built on core AWS IaaS primitives (EC2, S3, SQS). A custom Python autoscaler launches and terminates EC2 instances on demand for real-time inference — managed services were deliberately avoided to keep full control over scaling logic and resource management.

title: 3D Reconstruction using Fringe Projection
description: Reconstructs a 3D model of an object from projected fringe patterns using deep learning. Patterns are projected onto the object and captured by camera, then used to recover a depth map — with UNet, PSMNet and HRNet evaluated and calibration applied for final 3D surface profiling.

title: Fruit Quality Estimation
description: Detects and classifies defects on fruit from images of fruit laid out on the ground. A modified Transfiner model localises individual fruit, and each fruit region is passed to a second Transfiner model for defect detection. Published at ICIVC 2024 (Springer LNNS vol. 904).

title: Fruit Dimension Estimation
description: Estimates the size and weight of fruit directly from tree images, built in collaboration with agritech company Vegrow. Deep learning, statistics and camera calibration combine to produce final measurements in millimetres, validated across extensive field tests for robustness.

title: Human Pose Estimation and Tracking
description: Estimates human skeletons from video input. An OpenPose model predicts Part Affinity Fields and Confidence Maps, which are combined to recover and track full human poses across frames.

title: Face Mask Detection
description: Deep learning classifier that detects whether a face in an image or video frame is wearing a mask, built as an end-to-end notebook covering data preparation, training and evaluation.

title: Stock Analysis and Prediction Using LSTM
description: Time-series analysis and price forecasting on historical stock data using LSTM networks, covering feature preparation, sequence modelling and evaluation against simpler baselines.

title: Sentiment Analysis Using Machine Learning
description: Text sentiment classification pipeline covering preprocessing, vectorisation and model comparison across classical ML classifiers, evaluated on held-out review data.

title: Customer Segmentation
description: Unsupervised segmentation of customers into actionable groups using clustering on behavioural and demographic features, with exploratory analysis and cluster interpretation.

title: Virtual Healthcare Assistant
description: Final-project virtual healthcare assistant that interprets user-described symptoms and returns guidance, built as a notebook-driven NLP and modelling pipeline.

title: Automatic Performance Evaluation System
description: Hackathon build from VillageHacks: an automated system for scoring and evaluating performance submissions, replacing a manual review step with a programmatic pipeline.

title: DeepSeek in Colab
description: A reproducible Colab notebook for running and experimenting with DeepSeek models on free GPU tiers, covering environment setup, model loading and inference.

title: Missile Guidance using Proportional Navigation Law
description: Implements proportional navigation guidance so a missile can track a target trajectory and continuously adjust heading, simulated and validated in MATLAB. The most-starred project on the profile.

title: Seismic Signal Analysis using Synchrosqueezing Transform
description: Detects frequency components in seismic waves using the wavelet transform, then applies synchrosqueezing reassignment to sharpen the time-frequency representation.

title: FM Modulation using Simulink
description: Frequency modulation and demodulation modelled in Simulink, covering carrier generation, modulation and recovery of the baseband signal.

title: Batch XML to JSON
description: Small Python utility that converts a whole directory of XML files to JSON in one pass — built to remove a repetitive preprocessing step from data pipelines.

title: Retail App
description: Retail storefront prototype covering product browsing and cart flow, built as a front-end exercise in layout and state handling.

title: E-Commerce React Frontend
description: React front end for an e-commerce flow — product listing, detail views and cart state — built to practise component architecture and client-side routing.

title: 2D Platformer
description: Unity 2D platformer built in C# — player movement and physics, collision handling, level layout and simple enemy behaviour.

title: 2D Game
description: Unity 2D game project in C#, covering scene setup, sprite animation and the core gameplay loop.

title: Bubble Shooter
description: Classic bubble-shooter built in Unity with C# — aiming, colour-matching and chain-clearing mechanics.
